messages:
jess: deploybot auto-paused orbit-api rollout (v2.5.0) in us-west after ~11% 503s on canary :rotating_light:

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Release hold placed: orbit-api@2.5.0. Trigger: canary error rate > 10% for 5m. Remaining phases paused.

nate: any quick telemetry pointers? latency p50/p95 or logs?

sre-bot: pulling canary traces and kvcache logs now. early correlation: eviction + context-switch spikes after yesterday's kernel tuning. uploading to incident INC-2026-1301.

jess: not rolling forward. proposal: pin warm pools to 2.4.3, cancel pending canary slots, schedule a backfill window in low-traffic hours.

releases-bot: suggested backfill window: 2026-03-23 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). Owners: nate (SRE), jess (deploy), arun (releases).

nate: executing manual pin + pause:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/orbit-api orbit=registry/redwood/orbit:2.4.3 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/orbit-api
```

nate: pinned warm pools to 2.4.3 and paused rollout.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Manual action recorded: image pinned to orbit:2.4.3 by nate. Rollout paused.

jess: abort canary retries so they don't re-hit the same hosts.

nate: aborted canary jobs and cleared retries.

sre-bot: cordoned affected hosts and reverted kernel param on the node-pool. running a 45m soak, will post results.

arun: updating release notes: v2.5.0 "paused - regression (kvcache eviction)". linked INC-2026-1301.

jess: added action list to the release ticket:
- SRE: confirm node-pool health + 45m soak
- CI: run regression suite for v2.5.0 in sandbox after soak
- Releases: mark paused in Console and block auto-promote
- Decide: re-canary v2.5.0 or ship patched v2.5.1 in next window

nate: soak looks stable so far (20m in). will report after full window.

arun: scheduled stakeholder update at 2026-03-22 16:00 UTC.

jess: leaving hold in place until regression tests pass and releases owner gives explicit clear.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Hold remains; automated resume blocked until manual clear by release owner.

jess: closing thread for now, will reopen on requeue or if we switch to a patch release.

arun: reminder: restore automated retries only after explicit manual clear.
